field.name: body
field.p: Follow reception from a first enquiry to the next agreed visit, collect a charge through Reception POS, and hand off supplies, laboratory orders and equipment service to the operations team.

Willow Dental is a sample practice. Its people, contact details, fees, supplier terms, stock batches and service intervals form an example dataset for this walkthrough. Configure the practice's own details and approved schedules before real use.

Open Practice Desk. Patient Journey is the single pipeline; Diary opens practitioner appointments; and Reception POS opens the reception payment setup. The financial, supplies, paperwork and team entries lead to the corresponding native Odoo records.

tr.td: Enquiries, registration, diary coordination, financial proposals, reception collection and follow-up.
Supplies, purchasing, laboratory coordination and equipment servicing.

field.p: Use Jamie Reed for reception and Administrator to inspect the whole practice. My Activities shows the signed-in user's work. Open a patient, opportunity, product or order to inspect work assigned to someone else.
field.h2: Receive an enquiry from the website
field.p: Visit the Willow Dental homepage, then explore Our care, Our practice and Fees and first visit. The New patients form asks for a name and email, with optional phone, preferred times and an administrative message.

The form creates an opportunity for reception and shows the enquiry confirmation page. It does not book a slot or email a reply. Book a visit opens the native appointment page for choosing a practitioner slot.

Open James Walker in Patient Journey. His source is Google Business Profile and his next task is a callback. Confirm his contact details, agree a time and check for the Patients tag on his existing contact. Schedule the examination from his opportunity and select that contact as an attendee.
The stages are New enquiry, Appointment, Treatment proposal, Follow-up and Next step agreed.
Open Patient Journey from Practice Desk. Record attendance on the appointment and proposal preparation on the Sales quotation.

ol.li: Move James through contact and booking after agreeing an actual diary slot.
Open Sophie Taylor to follow a referred patient with a first examination and draft quotation. Record attendance on the diary booking.
Continue any financial proposal on the same opportunity. Review the quotation, record when it was shared and keep a dated follow-up until the decision is known.
Use Next step agreed when reception has recorded the outcome and next arrangement. The won stage records that administrative handoff; it does not record treatment completion or payment.

field.p: Aisha Khan has a shared quotation and a decision follow-up. Daniel Morgan has an accepted order and a future booking. Oliver Hughes has a consultation arranged directly at reception. Riley Carter's enquiry is closed with Appointment availability unsuitable; find it using the lost-record filters when reviewing enquiry outcomes.
field.h2: Use practitioner diaries and working hours
field.p: Open Diary and review Sophie's examination or Oliver's consultation. Check the practitioner, patient, time, duration and appointment type. Jamie and Administrator have shared access to Maya's and Alex's practice calendars.

The four appointment types schedule users for examinations, hygiene, urgent consultations and treatment sessions. Review employee working hours and approved time off before offering another slot. In Team, compare Maya's approved absence with Alex's pending request and its approval decision.

The diary includes new examinations for Ben Carter, Ethan Mills and Noah Clarke; hygiene visits for Nora Patel, Freya Brooks and Lily Morgan; Zoe Martin's urgent consultation; and treatment sessions for Priya Shah and Hannah Reed. Ben also has a previous no-show, and Freya has an attended examination.

Upcoming visits span Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday at initial loading; recent visits are on the previous working day. The dates remain anchored afterward. Checked-In records attendance. Record a cancellation or no-show through the normal appointment controls, then update the journey and next activity.

The sample diaries use Only internal users visibility. Bookings inherit that calendar setting so reception can see them in appointment counters and schedules. The calendar event is the booking: its appointment type, practitioner, patient, capacity and CRM opportunity are linked together.

Open Ben Carter for the missed and rearranged examination plus the draft proposal; Priya Shah for a treatment booking and accepted order; or Freya Brooks for an attended examination, its unpaid invoice, next hygiene booking and separate draft hygiene proposal. The related bookings and quotations open from each opportunity's native smart buttons.
field.h2: Prepare a quotation from the diary
field.p: Open the full appointment form in Diary and choose Create Quotation. Review the patient and add the agreed services and fees in Sales. When the patient accepts, confirm the quotation to make it a sales order.

Open Quotations / Orders on a linked visit to continue the existing document. Use Appointment on the quotation or order to return to the diary. Nora's hygiene visit and Priya's treatment session already have linked orders.
field.h2: Collect an existing invoice at reception
field.p: Freya Brooks has a confirmed examination invoice awaiting payment. Open Financial → Unpaid Patient Invoices, review her balance, then use Reception POS → Freya → Settle invoices. The example leaves the invoice unpaid for you to complete; no collection or external message was sent.

From an opportunity or contact, choose the activity plan and reference date. Reception tasks go to the Dental Reception role, with Jamie and Administrator as members. Review the dates and select Schedule. Open Practice Desk → Reception Tasks to claim unassigned tasks.

ul.li: Dental enquiry callbacks: response on the enquiry date, retry after two days and an outcome review after five days.
Dental estimate decision: contact after two and seven days from sharing, then an outcome review after ten days.
Dental post-visit reception follow-up: a next-day check-in and next-booking review after three days from the visit.

field.p: Launch plans manually and remove unused activities when the outcome is known. Review dates outside opening days. Grace Wilson's post-visit task and Emma Lewis's overdue callback provide starting points. For a later recall, create a separate Call on the date agreed with the patient and practitioner. Select and review an email template separately when correspondence is needed.
field.h2: Collect a Sales order through Reception POS
field.p: Open Reception POS, choose Reception and open the session. Review opening cash. The Willow Dental Fees pricelist supplies the configured service fees; check the amount and applicable taxes before collecting.

ol.li: Select Nora Patel, then open Quotation / Order. Choose her hygiene quotation, identified by RECEPTION-HYGIENE-VISIT.
Select Settle the order. Review the linked hygiene line rather than adding the hygiene service again from the product grid.
Choose Cash or Card and validate only after receiving the payment. Card records a payment completed through the external card process; no terminal provider is connected.

field.p: Nora's quotation starts open, with no invoice or payment. For Daniel's accepted order, use Quotation / Order and Apply a down payment (percentage) or Apply a down payment (fixed amount). The native link keeps the collection and down payment attached to his Sales order.
field.h2: Collect an existing invoice without a second sale
field.p: Open Grace's linked invoice. If it is still a draft, review it and select Confirm before collection. Return to Reception POS, select Grace, open the customer menu and choose Settle invoices.

Select the posted invoice, review the outstanding amount and enter the collection. This pays the existing receivable. Adding another hygiene line as a new sale would duplicate the charge. Partial collection is supported; this invoice-settlement screen does not accept change or a Customer Account payment.

Use a new product-grid sale only when no order or invoice already represents the charge. Use the Invoicing app's Pay flow for a payment handled there instead. Review cash, receipts and accounting handoff before closing the POS session. No POS session or payment has been completed for this walkthrough.

Open Paperwork for Sophie's patient registration request and the autoclave supplier-service-report request. Upload the received document or use the standard request/share flow when an external upload is needed. Check staff access to the private practice folders before sharing.

Signing Templates contains Willow Dental - Patient registration and Willow Dental - Financial proposal acknowledgement. Signature Requests contains Sophie's registration and Aisha's proposal acknowledgement, ready for review and sending. They are unsigned, with no invitation or reminder sent during loading.
Aisha's acknowledgement records receipt of the proposal. Acceptance follows her Sales quotation. Keep the contact, journey, financial document and next booking consistent.
field.h2: Count stock and review a replenishment quote
field.p: Open Supplies and inspect procedure masks: 150 units are on hand against a minimum of 200. Suction tips and pouches are also below their minimum. Review vendor pack sizes and lead times before ordering.

Use the Inventory app's Operations → Adjustments → Physical Inventory screen for Dental Supplies. Count individual units, convert unopened packs, review differences and select Apply. The location has a weekly count cycle. Launch Weekly supply check manually to assign counting, expiration review and replenishment review.
Replenishment rules are Manual. The RFQ SUP-2026-0041 already requests masks, tips and pouches; inspect it before creating another order. Appointments do not consume supplies automatically.

The catalogue also includes Dental cotton rolls, Disposable examination mirrors, Surface disinfectant wipes, Disposable tray liners and Prophy paste - single-dose cups. Open Replenishment Rules for their minimum and maximum levels, preferred vendor and purchase pack size. Mirrors, wipes, liners and paste cups start below minimum so there is work to review. Use the native replenishment action after checking stock and open purchases; the rules do not place orders automatically.

For composite syringes, lot CR-260818A holds six units. Lot CR-251205B holds two units, with an alert date reached and expiration in 14 days at initial loading. Check manufacturer labels and the practice's handling procedure, then review replacement needs.
field.h2: Follow receipt, vendor billing and laboratory work
field.p: Purchase SUP-2026-0038 has been confirmed and received. Its delivery adds four boxes of 100 gloves, two packs of 500 bibs and five boxes of 100 cups. Open the receipt and linked draft vendor bill to compare quantities, prices, vendor reference and taxes. Confirm the bill only after review; supplier payment is pending.

Laboratory case LAB-2026-0017 is a confirmed service order, due seven days after initial loading with a follow-up call after five days. Confirm the delivery date with Cedar Dental Laboratory and reception, record the received service quantity on delivery, and review the laboratory bill. It starts without a receipt or bill.

Open Equipment for the two treatment units, compressor and autoclave, then review their Maintenance Requests. Casey coordinates the Practice Equipment work and collects supplier reports in Equipment Records.

The queue contains four planned services, Chair 2 - suction connection leak in progress, and Compressor - intermittent pressure warning awaiting supplier assessment. The two repair activities show today's reception handoff and an overdue supplier callback.

Review planned dates and recurring intervals against the approved equipment schedule. After the work and report are complete, set the request state to Done to create its next occurrence. Moving a card to another stage alone does not do this.
